description: Deterministic routing from general operator topology and shape/dtype properties to knowledge-base references. Routing keys off the shape of the computation, never off an operator name, so a new operator with a known topology reuses knowledge automatically and no benchmark operator gets a bespoke path.
selection_rule: An operator may match zero or more topologies. Record every actual match with no override or single winner; omitting an actual match is invalid. An empty topologies array asserts that routing was evaluated and no current topology key matched; it must not mean unknown or skipped, and no best-fit category is forced. Collect the union of constraints routed by matched topologies (an empty union is valid), then add every applicable constraint from property modifiers, the target gate and mandatory constraints. Constraints are correctness obligations and are never truncated. The pattern candidate pool is the union routed by matched topologies and applicable property modifiers; retain all and only candidates that have a distinct, concrete design effect for the class. Pattern count is not capped. If no pattern fits, record no_matching_pattern while retaining all applicable constraints.

contract.description: The vocabulary shared with whatever validates the artifacts this KB's routing produces. This file is the single source; a consumer reads it rather than keeping its own copy. See CONTRACT.md.
contract.consumer: this repository's Stage 1-4 flow: pypto-pro-op-plan writes KB_SELECTION.json, pypto-pro-op-develop writes implementation claims to KB_USAGE.json, and pypto-pro-op-verifier independently validates both before the orchestrator completes the corresponding stage.

elementwise.note: One output element per input element. No cross-lane data movement, so the decision is authoring style (vf vs tile op) and tile width, not dataflow. Runtime-variable input arity is routed through the `is_list` property modifier because the parameter boundary is orthogonal to topology.

row-reduction.note: Each row reduces to a scalar that is broadcast back along the row. Covers norm, softmax-style and mean/variance shapes.

scan.note: Prefix-dependent output: element i depends on elements 0..i. The routed pattern covers the inner>1 / inner==1 split, rows-on-lanes with a padded gather pitch, and the reduced parallelism at outer==1. A class with no applicable pattern records no_matching_pattern.

gather-scatter-indexing.note: Data movement driven by an index tensor. Index dtype width and out-of-range/duplicate-index semantics dominate correctness. On a vector-only target the binding constraint is that vf.gather reads UB only, so the pattern is about what has to be resident before the gather, not about the gather.

cube-matmul.note: Contraction over a shared dimension on the cube unit.

quantized-matmul.note: Integer contraction. The epilogue is either an explicitly scaled/rounded/clamped integer output or a direct floating-point epilogue; the two have different formula oracles, so select the pattern by the epilogue the operator actually has. It inherits cube tile geometry and L0/L1 budgeting from cube-matmul because quantization modifies a contraction rather than defining an unrelated computation topology.

multi-phase-fusion.note: Several dependent phases in one kernel, with state carried between them.

long-axis.note: One axis exceeds what a single tile can hold, forcing multi-tile traversal with carried state.

paired-lane-rotation.note: Two lanes of the innermost axis form a pair transformed by a coefficient looked up from a small table indexed by a position derived from an outer index. Any 2x2 rotation whose angle varies along an outer axis has this shape; rotary position embedding is one instance, not the definition.

row-wise-dynamic-quant.note: Each row is quantized by a scale derived from that same row, and the scale is itself an output. Distinct from row-reduction because the reduction result leaves the kernel rather than only being broadcast back.

target_gated.constraints/arch-a5.md: Load when runtime/build configuration selects A5, or when no target is specified and the workflow default A5 applies.
target_gated.patterns/cv-quant-matmul-direct-epilogue: A5 only. Load only after target detection selects A5. The page freezes A5 memory capacities, event mapping and width gates, so a non-A5 planner routed here by operator class alone would take A5 constants as general.

constraints/wrapper-boundary.md.reason: Applies to every class regardless of topology. The public callable must not dispatch host-side tensor kernels around the single PyPTO-Pro kernel launch.
